'''2014 Worlds Reset Beta Brian Bolletta DS This Deal Is Getting Worse All The Time''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Brian Bolletta]] at [[2014 World Championship Reset Beta]].

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[Brian Bolletta]]
* '''Event:''' [[2014 World Championship Reset Beta]]
* '''Stage:''' Results
* '''Format:''' [[Open]]
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]

* '''Starting Interrupt:''' [[Prepared Defenses]]
* '''Source:''' [https://www.starwarsccg.org/worlds-2014-reset-beta-event-brian-bolletta-ds-tdigwatt/ PC list]
